# `compat/healers/error-healer.js`

> **Source:** `engine/compat/healers/error-healer.js`

healers/error-healer.js — enable scoped error capture for the guest. Marks the profile so the bootloader installs error/unhandledrejection capture (Phase 7's recovery layer reads `healing.captureErrors`). Kept as its own pass so the recovery policy can grow independently.

## Functions

### `healErrorPolicy({ profile }, report)`

healers/error-healer.js — enable scoped error capture for the guest. Marks the profile so the bootloader installs error/unhandledrejection capture (Phase 7's recovery layer reads `healing.captureErrors`). Kept as its own pass so the recovery policy can grow independently.
